card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a long medical word split into parts, most often the "ar" in "antimalarials" in drug-interaction lists. Also "yme" in Lyme, "ast" in nonmetastatic and "as" in extravasation.

modes.label: antimalarials
modes.description: The "ar" piece inside "antimalarials" in lists of drug classes.

modes.label: Other split medical terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of other split medical words such as Lyme, metastatic or extravasation.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long medical word, mainly "antimalarials", and has no clear effect on what comes next.
